description: This file contains validation functions for Kubernetes batch jobs, including validation of job specifications, status, and related policies. It defines constants, validation rules, and functions to ensure correctness and consistency of batch job objects within the Kubernetes codebase.

methods.name: validateGeneratedSelector
methods.description: Validates that the generated label selector on a batch.Job matches the expected labels based on job UID and name, ensuring correct pod selection.

methods.name: ValidateJob
methods.description: Validates a batch.Job object, including metadata, selector, and spec, returning a list of validation errors.

methods.name: ValidateJobSpec
methods.description: Validates a batch.JobSpec, including fields like parallelism, completions, policies, and pod template, returning validation errors.

methods.name: ValidateJobStatus
methods.description: Validates the status of a batch.Job, including counters and conditions, with options for strict validation.

methods.name: ValidateJobUpdate
methods.description: Validates an update to a batch.Job, ensuring metadata and spec immutability where required.

methods.name: ValidateJobUpdateStatus
methods.description: Validates an update to the status of a batch.Job.

methods.name: ValidateJobSpecUpdate
methods.description: Validates updates to a batch.JobSpec, including immutability checks and specific field validation.

methods.name: IsJobFinished
methods.description: Checks if a job has completed or failed based on its conditions.

methods.name: IsJobComplete
methods.description: Checks if a job has a 'Complete' condition set to true.

methods.name: IsJobFailed
methods.description: Checks if a job has a 'Failed' condition set to true.

methods.name: isJobSuccessCriteriaMet
methods.description: Checks if the job's success criteria condition is met.

methods.name: isJobFailureTarget
methods.description: Checks if the job's failure target condition is met.

methods.name: IsConditionTrue
methods.description: Utility to determine if a specific condition type is true in a list of job conditions.

methods.name: IsConditionFalse
methods.description: Utility to determine if a specific condition type is false in a list of job conditions.

methods.name: validateFailedIndexesNotOverlapCompleted
methods.description: Ensures that failed indexes do not overlap with completed indexes in job status.

methods.name: validateIndexesFormat
methods.description: Validates the format of index strings, returning total count and error if invalid.

methods.name: parseIndexInterval
methods.description: Parses a string representing an index interval (e.g., '0-5') into start and end integers, validating order and bounds.
